title: Daisy
novel:
After their fight, Lily suddenly [[disappeared|disappear]] from the hotel. Marshall was [[worried|worry]] and [[enlisted|enlist]] Ted and Barney to help him find her. They searched the entire hotel but could not find any [[clue|clue]] to where she had gone.

Marshall was [[frantic|frantic]]. He called Lily's phone repeatedly, but she did not answer. He feared that she had left the wedding entirely. Ted tried to [[reassure|reassure]] him, saying that Lily probably just needed some time alone to cool down.

Barney, despite being busy with wedding preparations, agreed to help. The three men [[tracked|track]] Lily's movements through the hotel security cameras. They saw her leave the hotel and get into a taxi.

They followed the taxi to a garden center outside of town. There, they found Lily sitting among the flowers, looking [[peaceful|peaceful]]. She was holding a small potted [[daisy|daisy]] plant.

Lily [[explained|explain]] that she had not run away. She had come to the garden center because she needed to think. She told Marshall that she was still upset about the judge job, but she did not want to fight anymore. She had come here because the flowers helped her feel calm.

Marshall was [[relieved|relieve]] to see that Lily was okay. He [[apologized|apologize]] again for his mistake and promised to always include her in important decisions. Lily smiled and accepted his apology.

The group returned to the hotel with the daisy plant. Lily placed it on the windowsill of their room. She said the daisy reminded her that even after a [[storm|storm]], beautiful things could [[grow|grow]]. The gang was [[grateful|grateful]] that the conflict was over and the wedding could go on.

enlist.en: He enlisted his friends to help.

reassure.en: He reassured her that everything was fine.

daisy.en: She picked a daisy from the field.

relieve.en: He was relieved to see her.

storm.en: The storm caused a lot of damage.

grateful.en: She was grateful for the help.
